zh: 🔴 **請把你的每一台裝置都更新到這一版。** 這一版開始，開了前向保密的對話會用新的加密方式。**沒更新的那台裝置會解不開送來的訊息，而且是永久的**——不是晚點會補上，是那台沒有對應的金鑰。手機、桌機、任何你還在用的裝置，一台都不要漏。
🧪 **後量子加密已啟用（實驗性）。** 上一版說「元件已就位、尚未啟用」，這一版把它打開了。它解決的是一個今天就在發生的問題：中繼站上的密文可能被側錄下來留著，等到未來有足夠強的量子電腦再解開。這一版起，那些密文**在未來也解不開**。
⚠️ **這不等於「量子安全」，請不要這樣理解。** 換掉的只有「內容加密」那一半；**簽章沒有改**，所以一個擁有量子電腦的攻擊者**仍然偽造得出訊息**。買到的只有一件事：內容的機密性。
⚠️ **前向保密（含這次的後量子）仍是實驗性選項、預設關閉，且尚未經過外部密碼學審計。** 我們用的組合方式是依標準做法自行組出來的，沒有照搬任何已經公開審查過的方案。要不要打開由你決定，設定→隱私。
📈 **代價：每則訊息大約多 1.4 KB。** 只在雙方都更新、且你開了前向保密時才會發生；對方沒更新就自動退回原本的方式，訊息照樣送得到。檔案本體走點對點，不受影響。
🔎 **降級偵測跟著升級了。** 如果某個聯絡人從較強的加密方式退回較弱的，你會看到提示；而單純收到對方的訊息**不會**再誤觸發那個提示（上一版的判斷會把「對方傳了一則訊息」誤讀成「對方退回較弱機制」）。
ℹ️ 已知：Android 版是測試版（debug 簽章，能接 USB 偵錯的人可讀取記憶體，請勿用它處理你真正在意的對話）；桌面版未經程式碼簽章，安裝時 Windows SmartScreen 會跳警告。
en: 🔴 **Update every device you use to this version.** From this release, conversations with forward secrecy enabled use a new encryption scheme. **A device left on an older version will not be able to decrypt incoming messages, permanently** — it is not a delay, that device simply does not have the matching key. Phone, desktop, anything you still use: do not skip one.

🧪 **Post-quantum encryption is now on (experimental).** The previous release said the pieces were in place but not switched on; this one switches them on. It addresses something happening today: ciphertext sitting on relays can be recorded and kept until a large enough quantum computer exists. From this version, that recorded ciphertext **stays unreadable**.

⚠️ **This is not "quantum-safe", please do not read it that way.** Only the content encryption changed; **signatures are unchanged**, so an attacker with a quantum computer could **still forge messages**. What you gain is confidentiality of content, and nothing else.

⚠️ **Forward secrecy, including this post-quantum work, remains an experimental option, off by default, and has not been externally audited.** The construction follows standard practice but is assembled by us; it is not a copy of any publicly reviewed scheme. Whether to turn it on is your call: Settings → Privacy.

📈 **The cost: roughly 1.4 KB more per message.** Only when both sides have updated and you have forward secrecy on; if the other side has not updated it falls back to the previous scheme and messages still arrive. File contents travel peer-to-peer and are unaffected.

🔎 **Downgrade detection was upgraded with it.** If a contact falls back from a stronger scheme to a weaker one, you will be told; and simply receiving a message from them no longer triggers that warning by mistake (the previous version could read "they sent a message" as "they fell back to a weaker scheme").

ℹ️ Known: the Android build is a test build (debug-signed; anyone with USB debugging access can read its memory — do not use it for conversations you actually care about). The desktop build is not code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen will warn during install.

zh: 🔴 **修正：把照片「拖」進對話窗時，位置資訊沒有被清除。** 按迴紋針選檔會清，拖放不會——而拖放是更常用的那一個。⚠️ **先前用拖放送出的照片已經帶著拍攝位置出去了，那無法回收**；收件者手上那份就是原檔。這一版起兩種方式都會清。
⚠️ **很大的圖片（超過 32 MB）仍然不會清除位置資訊**，因為重新編碼那麼大的圖會讓 App 當掉。這一版起送出前會**先問你一次**，不再是靜悄悄地送出去。想清掉的話，先縮圖再傳。
📶 **收檔終於看得到進度。** 以前對方傳大檔給你時，畫面上寫的是「檔案在你另一台裝置」——那句話是錯的，檔案正在傳進來。現在會顯示接收進度。
📱 **手機版補上一批一直缺的提示**：傳檔進度與失敗原因、通話打不通的原因（限制網路下建議改用 Wi-Fi）、本機空間已滿的警告、雲端備份的狀況、以及同事更新金鑰後的接續提示。這些桌面版一直都有。
💾 **「雲端備份已開啟」不再等於「備份成功」。** 設定頁現在會顯示上次成功備份的時間；如果從來沒成功過，它會說出來——以前那是完全安靜的，要到換機還原那天才發現。
✉️ **送出的訊息若對方一直沒收到，現在看得出來。** 中繼站只保存 7 天，超過就刪除。超過保存期仍沒收到送達回條的訊息會標成「可能未送達」，並建議重傳。
🕳 **離線太久回來時會提醒你可能漏了訊息。** 那段期間別人傳給你的東西可能已經在中繼站上過期消失，不會補送，也查不出漏了哪些。
🗂 **匯出紀錄不再有大小限制。** 用了很久的人匯出時可能會失敗，現在改成逐塊寫入，多大都行。
🖥 **桌面版選很大的檔案不再吃光記憶體**；網頁版的暫存檔也終於會被回收（以前會一直累積到空間滿了連訊息都存不下來）。
🔒 **加密機制的版本協商變嚴謹了**：如果對方從較強的加密方式退回較弱的，你會看到提示。以前這種情況是看不出來的。
🧪 **內部準備：後量子加密的基礎元件已就位**，但**尚未啟用**，目前不影響任何加密行為。它需要先讓大多數人更新到這一版之後才能打開——所以**請更新**。⚠️ 完成之後保護的是訊息內容的機密性，**不是**身分真實性；而且與現有的前向保密一樣**尚未經過外部密碼學審計**。
ℹ️ 已知：Android 版是測試版（debug 簽章，能接 USB 偵錯的人可讀取記憶體，請勿用它處理你真正在意的對話）；桌面版未經程式碼簽章，安裝時 Windows SmartScreen 會跳警告。
en: 🔴 **Fixed: photos **dragged** into a conversation did not have their location stripped.** Picking a file with the paperclip stripped it; dragging did not — and dragging is the more common action. ⚠️ **Photos you sent this way already went out with their capture location, and that cannot be undone**; the recipient has the original. From this version both paths strip it.

⚠️ **Very large images (over 32 MB) still do not get their location stripped**, because re-encoding something that large would destabilise the app. From this version you are **asked first** instead of it happening silently. To strip it, resize the image before sending.
📶 **Receiving a file finally shows progress.** Previously an incoming transfer said "file is on your other device" — which was simply wrong, the file was arriving. It now shows a progress indicator.

📱 **The mobile app gained a batch of notices it had been missing**: transfer progress and failure reasons, why a call could not connect (switch to Wi-Fi on restricted networks), a warning when local storage is full, cloud backup status, and continuity after a colleague rotates their key. The desktop app had all of these already.

💾 **"Cloud backup is on" no longer implies "backup is working".** Settings now shows when the last successful backup happened, and says so plainly if there has never been one — previously that was entirely silent until the day you restored onto a new device.

✉️ **You can now tell when a message you sent was never picked up.** Relays only hold offline messages for 7 days. A message with no delivery receipt after that window is marked "may not have been delivered", with a suggestion to resend.

🕳 **Coming back after a long time offline now warns you that you may have missed messages.** Anything sent to you during that window may have expired on the relay; it is not redelivered and there is no way to tell what was lost.
🗂 **Exporting your records no longer has a size limit.** Long-time users could hit a failure; it now writes in chunks, at any size.

🖥 **Picking a very large file on desktop no longer exhausts memory**, and the browser build finally reclaims its temporary files (they used to accumulate until storage filled up and messages could not even be saved).
🔒 **Encryption version negotiation is stricter**: if a contact rolls back from a stronger scheme to a weaker one, you are told. That case was previously invisible.

🧪 **Groundwork: the building blocks for post-quantum encryption are in place, but **not enabled** — nothing about encryption behaves differently yet. Turning it on requires most people to be on this version first, so **please update**. ⚠️ When it does land it protects the confidentiality of message contents, **not** the authenticity of identities; and like the existing forward secrecy it has **not been externally audited**.

ℹ️ Known limitations: the Android build is a test build (debug-signed — anyone who can attach USB debugging can read its memory, so do not use it for conversations you actually care about); the desktop build is not code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen will warn on install.

zh: 🔐 **更換了中繼站清單的簽章金鑰**。舊的那把曾經短暫存在於自動化流程中（2026-07-03 至 07-23），雖然沒有跡象顯示它外流，但既然無法排除，就換掉。這一版起你的 App 會認新的金鑰。
⚠️ **請更新到這一版**。舊版本仍然可以用，但它只認得舊金鑰，會逐漸收不到中繼站清單的更新。
📦 **傳整個資料夾**。把資料夾拖進對話窗就能傳；檔案超過 8 個時也會自動打包成一份，不再是幾十則訊息洗版。收到的人可以先看裡面有什麼，再決定要不要解開。
⚠️ 打包傳送時，裡面的相片**不會**像單獨傳送那樣清除位置資訊——送出前會先問你一次。
🔄 **大檔案斷線後接得回去**。傳到一半斷線，重連後從斷點繼續，不必整個重來。傳完會比對整檔的雜湊，確認接對了。
🛠 **App 裡就能建立自己的中繼站**。設定 → 連線與備份 → 建立我的節點，跟著五個畫面走完，大約三分鐘。它跑在你自己的 Cloudflare 帳號上。
🐛 修正：檔案傳到一半被移走時，那個對話之後就什麼都送不出去，而畫面只是停在「傳送中」。
📖 官網新增完整的自架教學。
ℹ️ 已知：Android 版是測試版（debug 簽章，能接 USB 偵錯的人可讀取記憶體，請勿用它處理你真正在意的對話）；桌面版未經程式碼簽章，安裝時 Windows SmartScreen 會跳警告。
en: 🔐 **The signing key for the relay list has been replaced.** The old one briefly lived in our automation (2026-07-03 to 07-23). There is no sign it leaked, but we cannot rule it out, so we replaced it. From this version your app trusts the new key.
⚠️ **Please update to this version.** Older builds keep working, but they only recognise the old key and will gradually stop receiving relay list updates.

📦 **Send a whole folder.** Drag it into the conversation. More than 8 files are packed into one bundle too, instead of flooding the chat with separate messages. The recipient can list what is inside before deciding to extract it.
⚠️ Photos inside a bundle do **not** get their location data stripped the way they do when sent individually — you are asked to confirm before sending.
🔄 **Large transfers survive a dropped connection.** Reconnecting resumes from where it stopped instead of starting over, and the whole file is hash-checked on arrival.
🛠 **Run your own relay from inside the app.** Settings → Connection and backup → Run my own node. Five screens, about three minutes. It runs on your own Cloudflare account.
🐛 Fixed: if a file was moved or deleted mid-transfer, that conversation could no longer send anything, while the screen just sat on "sending".
📖 A full self-hosting guide is now on the website.

ℹ️ Known limitations: the Android build is a test build (debug-signed — anyone who can attach USB debugging can read its memory, so do not use it for conversations you actually care about); the desktop build is not code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen will warn on install.

zh: 我的裝置：看得到這個身分曾在哪些裝置上出現，手機掉了可以從另一台把它移除——移除後那台就讀不到之後的新訊息。⚠ 已經收到的歷史救不回來；而且如果外流的是你的身分鑰匙本身（不只是一台裝置），移除擋不住
裝置鑰匙進了系統保管庫：桌面走作業系統金鑰庫、Android 走安全晶片，磁碟被複製也解不開。設定頁會如實顯示這台在哪一級——瀏覽器版只到「已加密」，那句話直接寫在畫面上
斜線指令：在輸入框打「/」開快捷選單；Enter 要送出還是換行現在可以自己設定（預設送出）
公司政策在手機上也生效了，並且會條列告訴你哪些功能被公司停用——先前手機端完全沒有套用，而且被停用時看起來只像是壞掉
手機的外觀、語言與主色現在會記住，重開 App 不再回到預設
手機的雲端備份改為每個身分各自獨立——先前是整台裝置一個開關，工作身分開了，個人身分也跟著開著
前向保密（實驗性選項、預設關閉、尚未經外部審計）：啟用後每週自動換一次鑰匙，可以隨時停用，保護範圍從一對一文字擴大到群組訊息、檔案名稱、共享行程與訊息回應。並修正一個多裝置的問題——先前在一台按「關閉」，會被另一台的備份翻回開啟
en: My devices: see which devices this identity has appeared on, and remove one from another device if a phone is lost — a removed device can no longer read new messages. ⚠ History it already received cannot be clawed back, and if what leaked was your identity key itself (not just one device), removal does not help

Device keys now live in the system vault: the OS keystore on desktop, the secure element on Android — a copied disk cannot open them. Settings states which tier this machine is actually on; the browser build only reaches "encrypted", and it says so on screen
Slash commands: type "/" in the composer for a quick menu; whether Enter sends or inserts a newline is now yours to choose (sends by default)
Company policy now applies on mobile too, and settings lists which features your company has disabled — previously mobile ignored policy entirely, and a disabled feature just looked broken
Appearance, language and accent colour are now remembered on mobile; reopening the app no longer resets them
Cloud backup on mobile is now per identity — it used to be one switch for the whole device, so turning it on for work turned it on for personal too

Forward secrecy (experimental, off by default, not yet externally audited): once enabled it rotates keys weekly, can be turned off at any time, and now covers group messages, file names, shared events and reactions in addition to one-to-one text. Also fixes a multi-device problem — turning it off on one device used to be flipped back on by another device's backup

zh: Android App 首次登場：可安裝的 APK，聊天、通話、群組、行事曆等功能與桌面同源
手機拍照直接傳：對話中點 📷 開相機，拍完立即送出
背景保持連線：以常駐通知讓訊息在 App 進背景時仍收得到——不使用任何第三方推播服務，沒有人會知道你何時收到訊息（可於設定關閉）
隱私修復：傳送圖片時自動清除 EXIF 等中繼資料——先前照片會連 GPS 座標、拍攝時間與裝置型號一起送出，現在只保留畫面內容（桌面與手機都已修正）
圖片傳送順帶壓縮：上傳更快、更省流量
en: Android app, first release: an installable APK — chat, calls, groups and calendar all share the same core as desktop
Take a photo and send it right away: tap 📷 in a conversation to open the camera

Stay connected in the background: an ongoing notification keeps messages arriving while the app is backgrounded — no third-party push service is used, so nobody learns when you receive messages (can be turned off in settings)

Privacy fix: image metadata (EXIF) is now stripped on send — photos previously carried GPS coordinates, capture time and device model; only the picture itself is sent now (fixed on both desktop and mobile)
Images are also compressed on send: faster uploads, less data

zh: 共享行程：在對話裡揪時間、RSVP 回覆、本機提醒（零中繼成本）；行事曆有月／週／日／清單四種檢視，預設本月月曆
訊息搜尋：對話內搜尋並跳到命中處、聯絡人清單搜尋、封存舊訊息也能搜（逐塊解密、不留索引）
無障礙：高對比模式（WCAG AA，可與深／淺色並用）、介面尺寸五段縮放、色覺友善色票
網址安全：訊息中的連結比對開源威脅情報（純本地比對，網址不外送），可自訂清單、嚴格模式或關閉
真隱身模式：隱身時完全停止在線廣播，連中繼都看不到你在線
經典 MSN 佈局：統一聯絡人列與狀態訊息、可收合分組、左側固定主視窗＋右側浮動對話窗
自訂 emoji／貼圖：匯入圖片自製 emoji、打 `:短碼:` 插入、批次匯入 Slack 式 emoji 包、收到自動收藏並加密保存
動畫 GIF emoji：支援會動的 GIF；大圖走內容定址傳遞、省頻寬
emoji／貼圖庫跨裝置同步：你自己的資產庫（含刪除）在各裝置間保持一致
多裝置同步強化：聯絡人／群組的刪除與解封會傳播，暱稱、標籤與偏好也跨裝置一致
訊息互動：一鍵複製、點文字開對話串、收回訊息加上所有權驗證與確認（可無痕收回）
通話更可靠：打不通時自動改走中繼（TURN），並在介面明確標示
正在聽：點 ♪ 可自動偵測目前播放的音樂（Windows 桌面版、預設關閉）
群組發言者名字有各自顏色，深／淺／高對比模式下都保證看得清楚
自架節點：中繼站提供 NIP-11 資訊文件、支援 NIP-62「立即清除我的資料」、可設定贊助入口
更新提示：有新版時在 app 內提示（可關閉自動檢查）
通知更細緻：事件細分開關＋每對話靜音
安全強化：匯入圖片格式與尺寸把關、供應鏈離線簽章、相依弱點掃描納入 CI
官網改版：預設英文＋淺色、新增企業版與產品比較頁、行動裝置可用性改善
內部：全平台版號統一（單一來源）＋app 內可顯示版本與本次更新內容
en: Shared plans: schedule inside a conversation, RSVP, and local reminders (zero relay cost); the calendar offers month / week / day / list views, defaulting to this month
Message search: search within a conversation and jump to hits, search the contact list, and search archived history (decrypt-and-discard, no index kept)
Accessibility: high-contrast mode (WCAG AA, combines with light/dark), five UI size steps, and colour-vision-friendly accents
Link safety: links in messages are checked against open-source threat intelligence entirely on your device (URLs are never sent anywhere); custom lists, strict mode, or off
True invisible mode: going invisible stops all presence broadcasts — even relays can't see you online
Classic MSN layout: unified contact list with status message, collapsible groups, fixed main window + floating chat windows
Custom emoji/stickers: import images as your own emoji, type `:shortcode:` to insert, bulk-import Slack-style packs, and received ones are saved encrypted automatically
Animated GIF emoji: GIFs stay animated; large ones use content-addressed transfer to save bandwidth
Emoji/sticker library syncs across your devices, deletions included
Better multi-device sync: contact/group deletions and unblocks now propagate, and nicknames, labels and preferences stay consistent
Message interactions: one-click copy, tap text to open a thread, and unsend with ownership verification and confirmation (traceless option)
More reliable calls: automatically falls back to relayed media (TURN) when a direct connection fails, clearly indicated in the UI
Now playing: click ♪ to auto-detect the music you're playing (Windows desktop, off by default)
Group speakers get their own name colours, guaranteed readable in light, dark and high-contrast modes
Self-hosting: relays now serve a NIP-11 info document, support NIP-62 "vanish my data", and can advertise a sponsorship link
Update prompts: get notified in-app when a new version is out (auto-check can be turned off)
Finer notifications: per-event toggles plus per-conversation mute
Hardening: image format/size validation on import, offline supply-chain signing, and dependency vulnerability scanning in CI
Website refresh: English + light theme by default, new Enterprise and product comparison pages, better mobile usability
Internal: unified versioning across all platforms (single source) with in-app version and what's-new

zh: 對話標題列新增「直連品質」晶片，一眼看出是否已建立 P2P 直連（文字訊息一律送達、不受影響）
解鎖畫面可直接「用其他身分登入」，不必先解鎖目前身分
跨網路 P2P 直連可靠性改進（一般模式加入預設 STUN）；企業強制 TURN 模式維持 relay-only、不外洩 IP
en: Direct-connection quality chip in the chat header — see P2P status at a glance (text messages always deliver regardless)
Sign in as another identity directly from the unlock screen, without unlocking the current one first
More reliable cross-network P2P (default STUN in normal mode); enterprise TURN-only mode stays relay-only and never leaks IPs
